analysis.missingness: Infrastructure-invalid attempts are separate; behavioral failures remain in denominators; missing values are null/NR, never zero.
analysis.nested_scene_warning: 27 seed replicates are nested within seven scenes and are not independent environments.
per_level: exact sign test with sign counts

design.optional_reflected_stage: not_registered_and_not_authorized; may be separately registered only after H4 passes at both levels
design.seed_source: prospectively fixed consecutive list 9400-9426; no E005 behavior existed at registration
design.whole_seed_atomic_block: Each seed's s0 LEFT/RIGHT and s1 LEFT/RIGHT cells remain on one lane.

final_cohort_stopping_rule: On completion, regardless of outcome, the experimental phase closes and the manuscript is written against the result.

frozen_task_contract.relation_definition: RoboTwin native region/cone and sign convention

layout.control: exact frozen RoboTwin scene reset for the assigned pair
layout.coordinate_boundary: Layout symmetry is checked in calibrated robot-frame y. Behavioral endpoints retain RoboTwin's frozen native outcome coordinate; no DROID axis is imported.
layout.name: symmetric object layout relative to the robot midline

symmetric.clutter: all other movable objects occur in same-asset/same-scale/same-material mirrored pairs
symmetric.reference: one reference instance centered at calibrated robot-frame y=0
symmetric.target: target centered at calibrated robot-frame y=0 and visible from every registered camera

H1.inference: 20,000-resample scene-clustered seed bootstrap CI and exact within-seed layout-label permutation
H1.interaction: seed-matched (s1 gap - s0 gap), reported separately for binary and depth
H1.prediction: directional gap is smaller at s1 than s0

H2.mde_rule: (z_0.95 + z_0.80) * observed paired seed SD / sqrt(27), z sum 2.48647486

H3.missing_share_policy: no failures means unavailable, never zero
H3.prediction: wrong-side share of failures rises s0-to-s1 while pick and transport share falls

H4.estimand: paired endpoint redirection = endpoint_LEFT - endpoint_RIGHT in frozen RoboTwin outcome coordinates
H4.if_fail: Do not interpret H1-H3; stop; supplement beside FastWAM; do not run reflected stage or another checkpoint.
H4.pass_at_each_level: mean > 0.05 m and scene-clustered 95% bootstrap CI excludes zero
